title: double or nothing
tagline: a binary style btc trading platform that lets users bet on direction of market
description: Orion lets users bet on whether the market will go up or down within seconds — directly on-chain using CashScript smart contracts for transparent, trustless outcomes. There are no custodians or middlemen; funds are locked in contracts and automatically settled based on real price data. The platform is designed to be simple, instant, and fun, while keeping the core ethos of crypto: self-custody and verifiability.
how_its_made: we used pyth Hermes api for realtime data streams and contracts are deployed on yellow blockchain to make it as accessible and decentralised as possible in a trustless manner and we are using wallet connect to let users connect and the pool is made of the bets in a 5 minute round leading to settlements
